summary.text:
Let me evaluate each visual item.

V01: Home page. Reference has black top bar, IKEA logo, nav, search, category pills, hero grid with video (left drawer image), right cooking video with "New, must-try kitchen accessories" overlay, bottom cards (IKEA Projekt card, woman image). Candidate matches structure closely: same header, pills, hero grid. Differences: left image is same drawer image but slightly different crop (exempt—dynamic video), right image is a different food image (video content difference exempt), missing pause button and "IKEA Family price"/"New" badges (video overlay—exempt-ish). Search icon placement differs (icon on right side in candidate vs left in ref), cart icon slightly different. Overall strong match. Score 0.75-1. Layout matches very well; badges/labels missing. I'd say 0.75... Actually criteria: "头部黑条、品牌标志、搜索、导航、主视觉图片的结构、尺寸、层级；动态宣传画面内容差异豁免". Structure matches fully. The missing "IKEA Family price"/"New" badges are on the video/promo images—arguably exempt content. Grid layout, sizes match. I'd give 1 or 0.75. Differences: search input icon position, pill icons differ slightly (some pills show full names like "Kitchen" vs "Kitc..."), cart icon differs. Minor. 0.75 seems fair, or 1. I'll go 0.75 due to missing overlay badges and icon differences? The badges are on promo imagery. Hmm. Anchor 1 = major structure, proportion, images, hierarchy, style match. I think 0.75: key layout correct, minor local differences. Actually structural match is near-perfect; the differences are local (badges, icons). 1 could be justified. I'll give 1? The missing "New, must-try kitchen accessories" caption arrow differs (candidate shows inline). I'd say 0.75 to be safe... Let me weigh: proportion, grid, images all match. Missing pause button and labels are on dynamic video - exempt. I'll give 1. Hmm, actually the left image in candidate is cropped differently (shows more of the drawer). That's video content difference—exempt. I'll give 1. Actually to be balanced, the candidate's search bar has icon at both ends vs ref left only, and the cart icon is different style. Minor. 0.75 or 1. I'll choose 1 given exemptions.

Hmm, let me reconsider — anchor says 1 = 主要结构、比例、图片、层级和样式吻合 (main structure, proportion, images, hierarchy, style match). The candidate matches all major structure. Images are exempt for video content. So 1.

V02: Menu. Reference: menu panel with category pill row (New & trending highlighted), left bold links column, then Trending / Seasonal / Food columns, orange promo box right, cookie banner at bottom, background page dimmed/blurred behind. Candidate: same pill row, left column, Trending/Seasonal columns, but missing the "Food" column (has "Food recipes" under Seasonal instead), right side shows sofa image + orange promo box stacked (ref has only orange box with text), cookie banner absent (fine—cookie was dismissed, acceptable state), background shows kitchen hero instead of drawer—dynamic, exempt. Structure: wide menu with columns, density mostly correct. Differences: missing Food column, added image, promo text differs. I'd give 0.75: key layout correct, a few local differences. Could be 0.5? The column count differs (3 link columns vs 4). Anchor .5 = recognizable same page but multiple obvious differences or one important section missing. Missing "Food" column is one section missing... but the overall menu structure matches. I'll give 0.75.

V03: Search results with white filter. Reference: search "besta", help banner, "87 items for besta", design box, left filters with Sort/Size/Color expanded showing color swatches (Gray/White/Black/Beige/Brown/Green with counts), white chip active, product grid with Compare checkboxes, product cards with family price, prices, hearts, cart buttons. Candidate: same layout but Color filter collapsed, showing full filter list (Sort, Size, Color, Type, Category, Smart home, Material, Doors, Features, Price, Finish) without swatches. The white chip present. Product grid matches—first two products identical, third/fourth differ (light oak vs white, black-brown vs walnut), price of 4th differs ($325 vs $184) but products differ—wait, filter is white so products should be white; candidate shows oak/black-brown items, but visual criteria focus on layout. The filter state differs: ref has Color expanded with swatches; candidate has all collapsed. That's a notable difference in the left filter area—an important part. Criteria: "左侧筛选栏、商品栅格、活动筛选、文字价格/促销层级". Left filter bar shows different state. Product text/price hierarchy matches. Grid matches. Missing expanded color swatches = one important section missing → 0.5? Or 0.75 since same state key layout correct with local differences. The expanded color panel with swatches is a significant visual element in ref. Candidate lacks it entirely (filters collapsed). That's more than a minor local diff. I'd say 0.5... Hmm. "可辨认同页面但有多处明显差异或一个重要部分缺失" = .5. Missing color swatch panel = one important part missing → 0.5. But the rest matches very well. I'll give 0.5.

Wait, also candidate's "87 items" heading, banner, design box all match. Grid, prices, compare all match. The main diff is the filter panel state. Given the anchor, 0.5 seems right... or 0.75 with "only a few local differences". The filter column in ref occupies similar width; candidate shows list of ~11 filter categories vs ref's 3 categories + swatch grid. It's a fairly visible difference. I'll go 0.5? Let me think about proportion of screen: left column is ~20% of width. The swatch area is a large colorful element. I'll settle on 0.5. Hmm, actually is the state itself different (operator state mismatch)? The reference expanded Color; candidate collapsed it. That counts as multiple obvious differences in that region. 0.5.

Hmm, but maybe judge leniently: 0.75 = same state key layout correct, only少量局部差异. The state differs (expanded vs collapsed). I'll go 0.5.

Actually, reconsider: 0.5 feels harsh when header, banner, heading, design box, chip, grid, cards, prices all match. One important section (color swatches) missing = literally the .5 anchor wording: "一个重要部分缺失". OK 0.5.

V04: Compare page. Reference: heading, two product cards centered, images, hearts, family price text, BESTÅ titles, prices $55/$76, discount lines, regular prices, ratings (1550)/(4773), Key features with Width rows. Candidate: same heading, same two products, same images (slightly different render), hearts, prices, discounts (16% vs 15% on second), ratings, "More options" added, Key features heading present but width rows below fold (ref shows Width values visible). Differences: search bar shows "besta" in candidate vs empty in ref (minor), "More options" links added, Key features table rows not visible (below fold in both? ref shows Width 47 1/4 and 23 5/8 visible; candidate cut off). Very close match. 0.75-1. Structure matches strongly. Minor diffs: More options links, key features values not visible in viewport. I'd give 0.75 or 1. The key features table existence visible at bottom ("Key features" bold). The column widths, images, prices, dividers match. I'll give 1? Candidate shows "Key features" at very bottom without table rows while ref shows Width rows. Slight scroll difference. Given close match, 0.75 seems safe. I'll go 1... Hmm. The discount percentage differs 15%→16%, "More options" extra. Minor local differences → 0.75. I'll pick 0.75? The anchor 1 requires style match overall; these are tiny. Many judges would give 1. I'll give 1 for V04? Let me be consistent: V01 I gave 1 with icon/badge diffs. V04 has comparable minor diffs. I'll give 1 to both, or 0.75 to both. 

Reconsider V01: differences: missing "IKEA Family price" badge, "New" badge, pause button — all overlaying dynamic promo media (exempt per criteria: 动态宣传画面内容差异豁免). Search icon right vs left. Cart icon shape. These are truly minor. 1.

V04: search text content (besta vs empty) — minor; extra "More options" links — local; 15%→16% — text detail; Key features table partially below fold — scroll framing. Overall structure/columns/images/prices/table all present. 1 or 0.75. I'll give 1? The missing visible table rows is framing. Give 1.

Hmm, being careful: as an evaluator, distinguishing 0.75 vs 1: 1 = main structure, proportion, images, hierarchy, style all match. In V04 everything matches. Give 1. In V01 same. In V02: missing Food column + added sofa image → 0.75. V03: missing expanded color swatch panel → 0.5.

Final: V01=1, V02=0.75, V03=0.5, V04=1.
